adaptations: RE2 ASCII classes/boundaries; whitespace excludes vertical tab except all-character classes.
Go end-of-text anchor converted to Python strict end-of-text anchor.

Domestic JSON candidate regex has one extra escaping layer; execution regex removes that layer.
Domestic JSON mask declarations match the runtime display masks.
